37708.meaning2: being carried off; being brought home

37709.meaning1: of disappointment; of disillusionment; of disenchantment; (comm) causing disenchantment

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato santike imā nibbejanīyā gāthāyo abhāsitvā tamhā ṭhānā apakkamma bhagavato avidūre pathaviyaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno kaṭṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhanto.

37710.commentary: (ANa) na ātappaṃ karoti tassa nibbeṭhanāyā'ti tassa abhūtassa nibbeṭhan'atthāya vīriyaṃ na karoti.

examples.text: bhūtena kho pana vuccamāno avajānāti, no paṭijānāti. abhūtena vuccamāno na ātappaṃ karoti, tassa nibbeṭhanāya iti'p'etaṃ atacchaṃ iti'p'etaṃ abhūtan'ti.

37712.grammar: prp of pass of nī √veṭh, pass, intrans
37712.commentary: (MNa) nibbeṭhiyamānam'eva paletī'ti pabbate vā rukkh'agge vā ṭhatvā khittaṃ suttapamāṇena nibbeṭhiyamānaṃ gacchati, sutte khīṇe tattha tiṭṭhati na gacchati. evam'evaṃ vuttakālato uddhaṃ na gacchatī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhiyamānam'eva paleti, evam'eva bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissantī'ti.

37713.meaning1: should be unravelled; should be explained
37713.meaning2: should be unravelled; should be explained
37713.commentary: (DNa) abhūtaṃ abhūtato nibbeṭhetabban'ti yaṃ abhūtaṃ, taṃ abhūtabhāven'eva apanetabbaṃ.

examples.text: mamaṃ vā, bhikkhave, pare avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi abhūtaṃ abhūtato nibbeṭhetabbaṃ, iti'p'etaṃ abhūtaṃ, iti'p'etaṃ atacchaṃ, n'atthi c'etaṃ amhesu, na ca pan'etaṃ amhesu saṃvijjatī'ti.

micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, na sarāmī'ti asatiyā nibbeṭheti.

37715.meaning2: having unravelled, having untwisted, having explained

examples.text: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kathaṃ bhāvitā nu kho, bhante, satta bojjh'aṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantī'ti?

examples.text: cha nibbedhabhāgiyā saññā, aniccasaññā anicce, dukkhasaññā dukkhe, anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā.

37719.commentary: (DNa) nibbedhabhāgiyā'ti nibbedho vuccati nibbānaṃ, taṃ bhajanti upagacchantī'ti nibbedhabhāgiyā.

37720.meaningLit: discourse on conducive to penetrating insight

37721.synonym: kaṇḍaka, tikkha, tibba, teja, pavedhaka, vedhī

examples.text: nibbedhikapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya, sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paññ'indriyaṃ

37722.meaning1: with incisive understanding; with penetrative wisdom
37722.commentary: (SNa) katamā nibbedhikapaññā? idh'ekacco sabbasaṅkhāresu ubbegabahulo hoti uttāsabahulo ukkaṇṭhanabahulo aratibahulo anabhiratibahulo bahimukho na ramati sabbasaṅkhāresu, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāletī'ti nibbedhikapaññā.

examples.text: sutavā nibbedhikapañño, sutavā nibbedhikapañño'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotī'ti
nibbedhikapañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. app'iccho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. santuṭṭho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. pavivitto, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. asaṃsaṭṭho, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto.

37723.meaning1: state of incisive understanding; fact of having penetrative wisdom
37723.commentary: (PM) nibbedhikapaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti katamā nibbedhikapaññā? idh'ekacco sabbasaṅkhāresu ubbegabahulo hoti uttāsabahulo ukkaṇṭhanabahulo aratibahulo anabhiratibahulo. bahimukho na ramati sabbasaṅkhāresu. anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāletī'ti, nibbedhikapaññā. anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāletī'ti, nibbedhikapaññā.

examples.text: katame cattāro? sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā nibbedhikapaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti.

37725.commentary: (ANa) anibbiddhapubbe appadālitapubbe lobhakkhandh'ādayo nibbijjhati padāletī'ti nibbedhikapariyāyo, nibbijjhanakāraṇan'ti attho.

examples.text: nibbedhikapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca

37727.meaning2: connected with recoiling; connected with despondency; giving up

37728.commentary: (VINa) yadā nibbematiko'ti ettha sace pan'esa nibbematiko na hoti, vatthuṃ kittetvāva desetuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti andhakaṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: tassa me saṅgho tassā āpattiyā dvemāsappaṭicchannāya dvemāsaparivāsaṃ adāsi. so'haṃ parivasanto itarissā'pi āpattiyā nibbematiko. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ saṅghaṃ itarissā'pi āpattiyā dvemāsappaṭicchannāya dvemāsaparivāsaṃ yāceyyan'ti.
abhidhāvatha bhaddante, kassa ujjhāpayāmase, ādittā nibbhataṃ bhaṇḍaṃ, puna ḍayhitum'icchasī'ti.
evaṃ addhāne gate bodhisatto, rājā maṃ sarati, mayā tattha gantvā tassa dhammaṃ desetvā taṃ nibbhayaṃ katvā āgantuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti

37731.meaning1: killjoy; spoilsport; who does not enjoy
37731.commentary: (VINa) brāhmaṇo tam'eva vayovuḍḍhānaṃ abhivādanakamm'ādiṃ loke sāmaggiparibhogo'ti maññamāno tadabhāvena bhagavantaṃ nibbhogo'ti āha. bhagavā pana yv'āyaṃ rūp'ādīsu sattānaṃ chandarāgaparibhogo tadabhāvaṃ attani sampassamāno aparam'pi pariyāyaṃ anujānāti.

examples.text: nibbhogo bhavaṃ gotamo'ti
asso'va jiṇṇo nibbhogo, khādanā apanīyati, bālakānaṃ pitā thero, par'āgāresu bhikkhati.

37743.meaning1: related to an invitation; to do with a request

examples.text: iti h'idaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya, tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikaṃ't'eva adhivacanan'ti.

37744.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.6) nimantito nāma pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantito.

examples.text: so tattha bhuttāvī ca hoti yāva'd'attho, nimantito ca svātanāya, piṇḍapāto c'assa pūro.
gaṇabhojanaṃ nāma yattha cattāro bhikkhū pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti. etaṃ gaṇabhojanaṃ nāma.
animantite nimantitasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. animantite vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. animantite animantitasaññī, anāpatti.

37748.grammar: prp of pass of ni √mant, pass, intrans (+instr)
37748.commentary: (VINa) nimantiyamāno bhikkhaṃ gahessāmī'ti bhaṇatī'ti bhattaṃ gaṇhā'ti nimantiyamāno na mayhaṃ tava bhatten'attho, bhikkhaṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti vadati.

examples.text: santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā piṇḍapātikā sapadānacārino uñch'āsake vate ratā, te antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhā samānā āsanena'pi nimantiyamānā na sādiyanti.
nimantiyamāno bhikkhaṃ gahessāmī'ti bhaṇati, niccabhatte, salākabhatte, pakkhike, uposathike, pāṭipadike, pañca bhojanāni ṭhapetvā sabbattha anāpatti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
na hi bhavaṃ gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti
yadā, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātubhavati, na tassaṃ parisāyaṃ koci devo abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.

37751.meaning1: having invited; having made an offer

examples.text: nibaddhaṃ mama gehaṃ pavisatha, aham'eva catūhi paccayehi upaṭṭhahissāmī'ti theraṃ nimantetvā pakkāmi.

anāpatti gilānassa, agilāno sakiṃ bhuñjati, gacchanto, vā āgacchanto vā bhuñjati, sāmikā nimantetvā bhojenti, odissa paññatto hoti, na yāva'd'attho paññatto hoti, pañca bhojanāni ṭhapetvā sabbattha anāpatti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sakyā c'eva sakyakumārā ca sandh'āgāre uccesu āsanesu nisinnā honti aññam'aññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghantā saṃkīḷantā, añña'd'atthu mamaññ'eva maññe anujagghantā, na maṃ koci āsanena'pi nimantesi.
bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañcapatiṭṭhitena vanditvā pānīyena nimantesi

37755.meaning1: without flesh and smeared with blood

37756.meaning1: name of a king; previous incarnation of the Buddha
37756.meaning2: name of a king; previous incarnation of the Buddha
37756.commentary: (CPa) nimi nāma mahārājā'ti nemiṃ ghaṭento viya uppanno nimī'ti laddhanāmo, mahantehi dānasīl'ādiguṇavisesehi mahatā ca rāj'ānubhāvena samannāgatattā mahanto rājā'ti mahārājā.

examples.text: nimi tesaṃ rājā pacchimako ahosi dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā, dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c'eva jānapadesu ca, uposathañ'ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ'ca pakkhassa.
ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabban'ti rūpena vā nimittena vā saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ
ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, indriyesu guttadvāro hohi, cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhī hohi m'ānubyañjanaggāhī.

37759.commentary: (ANa) kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasikātabban'ti-ādīsu taṃ taṃ kālaṃ sallakkhetvā ek'aggatāya yuttakāle ek'aggatā manasikātabbā. ek'aggatā hi idha samādhinimittan'ti vuttā. tatra vacan'attho, samādhi'y'eva nimittaṃ samādhinimittaṃ. sesapadadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.
rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati.
yathā kho, mārisā, nimittāni dissanti, uḷāro āloko sañjāyati, obhāso pātubhavati, brahmā pātubhavissati
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

37762.synonym: adhikaraṇa, adhiṭṭhāna, ākāraṇa, ārammaṇa, kāraṇa, ṭhāna, nidāna, nibandhana

examples.text: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti. tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessatī'ti nimittam'etaṃ, sāriputta, na samanupassāmi.

adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.

37763.meaning1: meditation object; theme of contemplation; mental hyperlink
37763.commentary: (ANa) tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti tasmiñ'ca samabhāve sati yena ādāse mukhabimben'eva nimittena uppajjitabbaṃ, taṃ samathanimittaṃ vipassanānimittaṃ magganimittaṃ phalanimittañ'ca gaṇhāhi nibbattehī'ti evam'assa satthā arahatte pakkhipitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathesi.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
paṭisevati nāma yo nimittena nimittaṃ aṅgajātena aṅgajātaṃ antamaso tilaphalamattam'pi paveseti, eso paṭisevati nāma.

37765.commentary: (UDa) oḷārike nimitte'ti thūle saññ'uppādane. thūlasaññ'uppādanañ'h'etaṃ, tiṭṭhatu bhagavā kappan'ti sakalakappaṃ avaṭṭhānayācanāya yadidaṃ yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā'ti-ādinā aññāpadesena attano caturiddhipādabhāvan'ānubhāvena kappaṃ avaṭṭhānasamatthatāvibhāvanaṃ.

examples.text: evam'pi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne, oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne, n'āsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ, na bhagavantaṃ yāci, tiṭṭhatu, bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.

37766.meaning1: making a sign; giving a signal
37766.commentary: (VINa) nimittakamman'ti saññ'uppādan'atthaṃ kassaci nimittassa karaṇaṃ, taṃ, akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇissāmī'ti-ādinā nayena tidhā vuttaṃ. aññam'pi pan'ettha hatthalaṅghana-pāṇippahāra-aṅguliphoṭana-gīv'unnāmana-ukkāsan'ādi-anekappakāraṃ saṅgahetabbaṃ. sesam'ettha saṅketakamme vuttanayam'evā'ti.

examples.text: nimittakammaṃ nāma nimittaṃ karoti, akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇissāmi bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipissāmi sīsaṃ vā ukkhipissāmi, tena nimittena taṃ jīvitā voropehī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
rāgo kho, āvuso, nimittakaraṇo, doso nimittakaraṇo, moho nimittakaraṇo.

37768.meaning1: skilled in signs; expert in markings

examples.text: abhiyogino ca nipuṇā, bahū pana nimittakovidā, sukhumanayanakusalā manujā, piyadassano'ti abhiniddisanti naṃ.

37769.meaning1: enticed by appearances; focusing on prominent features
37769.meaning2: enticing by appearances, grabbing onto the mental image; lit. grasping signs
37769.commentary: (SNa) anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho'ti hatthā sobhanā pādā sobhanā'ti evaṃ anubyañjanavasena nimittaggāho. nimittaggāho'ti hi saṃsandetvā gahaṇaṃ, anubyañjanaggāho'ti vibhattigahaṇaṃ. nimittaggāho kumbhīlasadiso sabbam'eva gaṇhāti, anubyañjanaggāho rattapāsadiso vibhajitvā hatthapād'ādīsu taṃ taṃ koṭṭhāsaṃ. ime pana dve gāhā ekajavanavāre'pi labbhanti, nānājavanavāre vattabbam'eva n'atthi.

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

37770.meaning1: grasping the external characteristics; focusing on prominent features
37770.meaning2: sensuously attracted, led away by outward signs
37770.commentary: (NIDD1a) nimittaggāhī'ti itthipurisanimittaṃ vā subhanimitt'ādikaṃ vā kilesavatthubhūtaṃ nimittaṃ chandarāgavasena gaṇhāti, diṭṭhamatte'y'eva na saṇṭhāti.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti n'ānubyañjanaggāhī.
cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī n'ānubyañjanaggāhī

37771.meaning1: fact of having a sign; fact of having an image
37771.construction:
ni + √mā > mi + tta + tā
nimitta + tā

37774.meaning1: with incomplete genitals; without fully-formed sexual organs
37774.commentary: (VINa) nimittamattā'sī'ti tava itthinimittaṃ aparipuṇṇaṃ saññāmattam'evā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

37775.meaning1: omens and auspicious marks; signs and characteristics

examples.text: bahuvividhanimittalakkhaṇaññū, atinipuṇā manujā byākariṃsu, bahuvividhā gihīnaṃ arahāni, paṭilabhati daharo susu kumāro.

37777.meaning1: bound by the gratification in the mental image
37777.meaning2: bound to enjoyment in appearances, attached to pleasure in mental image, tied to gratification in sign

examples.text: nimitt'assādagathitaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, anubyañjan'assādagathitaṃ vā tasmiñ'ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya

37778.meaning1: bound to gratification in the mental image

examples.text: nimitt'assādagadhitaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, anubyañjan'assādagadhitaṃ vā tasmiñ'ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya

37779.meaning1: picks up the subtle signals; catches the hint

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti, idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.

37780.meaning2: makes a sign; marks; indicates; distinguishes

37781.meaning2: marks, apprehends the characteristic features; apprehends an object or appearance (as distinguished in various ways); distinguishes, identifies an object or appearance

37782.meaning1: following signs; following after mental representations

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, atha ca pana me nimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī'ti.

37784.commentary: (JAa) mayā'pi sāmā nimineyya aññan'ti sāmā mayā'pi aññaṃ sāmikaṃ parivattetvā gaṇheyya.

examples.text: asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena, nimīni sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena, mayā'pi sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan'ti.
tassa kira sakkena saddhiṃ paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ nisinnassa akkhinimisamattena nānattaṃ paññāyati. taṃ asallakkhentā devā sakkassa ca tassa ca nānatte muyhanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso āpāthagatānaṃ rūpānaṃ adassanakāmo assa, so nimīleyya vā aññena vā apalokeyya.
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, cakkhumā puriso ummīletvā vā nimīleyya, nimīletvā vā ummīleyya

37795.meaning2: (of eyes) having closed; having winked; having blinked

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, cakkhumā puriso ummīletvā vā nimīleyya, nimīletvā vā ummīleyya

37797.meaning2: sunk down, dived in, plunged into

examples.text: udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udak'ānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni
seyyathā'pi, rājañña, puriso gūthakūpe sasīsakaṃ nimuggo assa. atha tvaṃ purise āṇāpeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ tamhā gūthakūpā uddharathā'ti.

37798.commentary: (DNa) anto nimuggaposīnī'ti udakatalassa anto nimuggāni'y'eva hutvā posīni, vaḍḍhīnī'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udak'ānuggatāni anto nimuggaposīni

37799.meaning2: sinks down, dives in, plunges into
37799.commentary: (VINa) nimujjati vā'ti-ādīsu nimujjan'atthāya orohantassa padavāre padavāre dukkaṭaṃ.

examples.text: udake hasadhammo nāma uparigopphake udake has'ādhippāyo nimujjati vā ummujjati vā palavati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
